name: Lynnwood Neighborhood Center
mission: Brings essential services and community spaces together in one location — youth programs, adult services, community resources, and wellness services — for Lynnwood, Edmonds, Mountlake Terrace, Shoreline, and surrounding communities.

name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Snohomish County
mission: Provides young people ages 5-18 with a safe and positive place to spend their time before and after school and during the summer, helping them reach their full potential as productive, caring, responsible citizens.

name: VOAWW Early Learning & Child Care
mission: High-quality, play-based early learning and ECEAP preschool with social-emotional support, parent engagement, and daily enrichment activities for young children.

name: Cocoon House
mission: Breaks the cycle of youth homelessness by providing shelter, housing support, family engagement, outreach, and education/employment services, meeting youth where they are.

name: ChildStrive
mission: Partners with families and the community to support the success of young children, building on family strengths with support, resources, and relationships that allow them to flourish.
address: 906 SE Everett Mall Way, STE 200, Everett, WA 98208
